title: Finger Exercise 20 — Container and Queue (FIFO)
statement:
Implement a `Container` base class and a `Queue` subclass.

`Container` (initializes `self.myList = []`):
- `size(self)` — return the length of the list.
- `add(self, elem)` — add `elem` to one end (keep the end consistent); returns nothing.

`Queue(Container)` — a **first-in, first-out** structure:
- `remove(self)` — remove and return the **oldest** element added, or `None` if empty.

```
q = Queue(); q.add(1); q.add(2); q.remove() -> 1  (FIFO)
```

Source: MIT OCW 6.100L Fall 2022, Finger Exercise Lecture 20 (reconstructed as a runnable problem for this study tool).
